description: Read the developer's profile (public name — a studio or company name, shown as the author of their apps and in the gallery; the email is never shown —, dashboard language, whether a Claude API key is saved, emails on the account) or change `name` / `lang`. Changing the name also updates the owner name on all their apps. Also their STUDIO (C213): the public page of all their published apps, play.neblla.com/studio/<studioSlug>, each app with its rating, reviews, subscription and Play; it is the business web on their Stripe account, and «by <name>» in the gallery links to it. The studio's name is `name`; `studioSlug` its short name (3-30, lower case letters, digits, hyphens; Neblla proposes one from the name), optional `about` (who they are, since when; up to 1500 characters, in their own words), `web` (their official site) and `links` ([{ label?, url }], up to 6). Send `about`, `web` or `links` as null or [] to clear them.

name.description: New public name: what users see as the author of the developer's apps (e.g. a studio or company name). The email is never shown.

studioSlug.description: The studio's short name: its page play.neblla.com/studio/<studioSlug>
